A shorter first appearance of the same typescripts ran in Przegląd Historyczno-Wojskowy 6 (2005), special no. 5, pp. 71-204, per the AMU bibliographic record. Coordinate is OSM's Collegium Martineum, Poznań; the Enigma Cipher Centre opened in that building on 24 September 2021, a day-date resting on the AMU press release alone.
stops.sun_caveat: year precision: the Sun could be in any sign; the reading above is for the stated (defaulted or conventional) day and should not be trusted
stops.moon_and_planets: omitted: the Moon changes sign every ~2.3 days; only day-precise stops get them

stops.segment: After
stops.stop: Bydgoszcz Główna, the station takes his name
stops.date_confidence: reconstruction [R] as to the ceremony: the gov.pl page reporting it, 'Kryptolog Marian Rejewski patronem dworca kolejowego Bydgoszcz Główna', did not resolve on refetch, so the 2 February 2022 date, the ranking as the ninth station named under the PKP programme and the attendee list are unconfirmed. Coordinate corrected from the pool's 53.1223/18.0114, which pointed at the city centre 2.1 km away, to OSM's Bydgoszcz Główna, 7 Zygmunta Augusta, 53.1353/17.9916. The 2005 bench, by Michał Kubiak per Wikipedia, and the 2017 mural 'Odszyfrowany Rejewski' by Juliusz Nowicki are both attested by Wikipedia.
